QuestInfo.name: [Tallahart] Phantasynch
QuestInfo.0: Apparently, someone is trying to send a message through the crystal ball. Talk to Nona.
QuestInfo.1: You'll have to synchronize with Noctis's power better to answer the call. Fight using Noctis's power on #bNight Road#k and #bPhantasmal Road#k to increase your synergy.
QuestInfo.2: You synchronized with Noctis's power and answered the call.

default.0: You'll have to do better than that, I'm afraid.
